name: company_responsibilities
description: The company's designated responsible administrator, who approves additional administrators (P10).
lifecycle: Created with the company; moves to another active administrator only when that successor accepts a pending responsibility transfer.

columns.Meaning: Company whose responsibility this row records; one row per company.
Membership of the responsible administrator in the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: Responsibility belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The responsible membership belongs to the same company.
Exactly one responsible administrator per company.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX company_responsibilities_membership_key ON public.company_responsibilities USING btree (company_id, membership_id)
constraints.Purpose: Supports the composite reference to the responsible membership.
